the process by which plants make oxygen from carbon dioxide and light
something that controls or keeps a process in balance
the layer of gases surrounding the Earth

grammar_choice.en_template: Approximately 15-20% of global greenhouse gas emissions {{1:are/is}} {{2:caused/causing}} by degradation and deforestation.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 전 세계 온실가스 배출량의 약 15~20%가 (산림) 황폐화와 삼림 벌채에 의해 발생한다.
explain: of 뒤 복수명사 emissions에 수 일치 → are.
배출량이 '발생되는' 대상 → 수동태 be caused by.

grammar_choice.en_template: Trees {{1:play/plays}} a huge role {{2:in/on}} the carbon cycle.

grammar_choice.en_template: They {{1:convert/converts}} the CO2 in the air to oxygen through the process of photosynthesis, and consequently, they {{2:are viewed/view}} as a natural regulator of carbon dioxide.

grammar_choice.en_template: The existence of a larger amount of trees will no doubt {{1:lead/leads}} to the {{2:reduced/reducing}} presence of carbon dioxide in the atmosphere and the increased existence of oxygen.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 더 많은 양의 나무가 존재하면 의심할 여지 없이 대기 중 이산화탄소의 감소와 산소의 증가로 이어질 것이다.
explain: '감소된 존재량' — 명사 presence를 수식하는 과거분사 reduced.

grammar_choice.en_template: Unfortunately, deforestation is {{1:preventing/prevented}} this process from {{2:being/be}} fully accomplished.

grammar_choice.en_template: And with half of the Earth's forests {{1:gone/going}}, the amount of carbon dioxide {{2:is/are}} progressively rising.

grammar_choice.en_template: With more carbon dioxide in the atmosphere, more of the sun's radiation is being reflected back to Earth instead of {{1:being/be}} released into space, and this is causing the planet's average temperature {{2:to rise/rise}}.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 대기 중에 이산화탄소가 더 많아지면서, 태양 복사의 더 많은 부분이 우주로 방출되는 대신 지구로 반사되어 되돌아오고, 이것이 지구의 평균 기온을 상승시키고 있다.

grammar_choice.en_template: Accordingly, deforestation {{1:is/are}} a major issue when it {{2:comes/come}} to global warming.

jumble.answer: Approximately 15-20% of global greenhouse gas emissions are caused by degradation and deforestation.
Trees play a huge role in the carbon cycle.
They convert the CO2 in the air to oxygen through the process of photosynthesis, and consequently, they are viewed as a natural regulator of carbon dioxide.
The existence of a larger amount of trees will no doubt lead to the reduced presence of carbon dioxide in the atmosphere and the increased existence of oxygen.
Unfortunately, deforestation is preventing this process from being fully accomplished.
And with half of the Earth's forests gone, the amount of carbon dioxide is progressively rising.

With more carbon dioxide in the atmosphere, more of the sun's radiation is being reflected back to Earth instead of being released into space, and this is causing the planet's average temperature to rise.
Accordingly, deforestation is a major issue when it comes to global warming.
